verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Windmill offering built-in AI-generated insights or suggestions about a user's data. The AI features documented are AI Agent steps that developers wire into flows (a building block), AI code generation and editing of workspace items (a different capability), and an MCP server that lets external LLM clients trigger scripts (also a different capability). None of these is first-party data-insight functionality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
